strings.zh: 爷爷关了狩猎场,{NEWLINE}腾出了空地。{CLEAR}这次换作爸爸{CLEAR}在那开始经营联动公园了！{SCROLL}我们家族继承着{NEWLINE}抓到精灵然后放走的血脉吧。
strings.en: My grandpa closed the Safari Zone{NEWLINE}and now that we have an empty lot,{CLEAR}my dad decided to run the Pal Park!{SCROLL}It seems that catching and releasing{NEWLINE}Pokémon runs in my family.
